MESSAGE FROM THE
        CHIEF ELECTORAL OFFICER, MANIPUR

                       The 18th Lok Sabha Elections, 2024, marked a defining moment in India’s
                         democratic history. With over 900 million voters, this was the largest
                             election ever conducted in human history. The people of Manipur
                            participated in this electoral process with great enthusiasm, reinforcing
                           the State’s tradition of high voter turnout and commitment to democracy.

                        Conducting elections in Manipur has always been a challenging task due
                            to its unique geographical terrain, diverse demographic composition and
                             prevailing law and order situation. However, the Election Commission of
                             India, along with the dedicated election machinery in the state, ensured
                             that the elections were conducted in a free, fair and peaceful manner.
                            Special emphasis was laid on accessibility, inclusivity and voter
facilitation, ensuring that no eligible voter was left behind.

One of the most significant achievements of the 2024 elections was the facilitation of voting for
Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs). Special Polling Stations were set up across relief camps in different
districts, ensuring that those affected by displacement were able to exercise their democratic right. This
was an unprecedented effort in our electoral process, reaffirming the Election Commission’s commit­
ment to leaving no voter behind.

Additionally, the state witnessed remarkable women’s participation, with all-women polling stations set
up across districts as a symbol of empowerment. Similarly, Persons with Disabilities (PwD) and senior
citizens were provided special facilities, including home voting, ensuring that they could vote with
dignity. The successful implementation of airlifting polled EVMs from remote and inaccessible areas
further strengthened electoral integrity and logistical efficiency.

The 2024 elections were not just about numbers but about the spirit of democracy. I extend my deepest
gratitude to all District Election Officers, Electoral Registration Officers, Booth Level Officers, polling
personnel, security agencies, political parties, media houses, civil society organisations and most
important, the voters of Manipur, for their unwavering commitment to the electoral process. Their
collective effort made this election a true celebration of democracy.

This Statistical Report 2024 provides a comprehensive overview of the election process, key statistics
and the various measures undertaken to ensure a smooth and transparent election. I hope this report
will serve as a valuable resource for researchers, policymakers and all stakeholders interested in the
electoral process of Manipur.


I wish the readers an insightful and informative experience.


Pradeep Kumar Jha
Chief Electoral Officer, Manipur
